title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of 30 MeV/c.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply conservation of energy in the decay process.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply conservation of momentum to relate the momenta of the muon and neutrino.

title: Correct Squaring
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly square the energy-momentum relation in their calculations.

title: Calculation Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show accurate calculations leading to the final momentum value.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of conservation laws.
